scope: Judged pool is the set of tables submission 08 retrieves and submission 00 does not, on the 233 benchmark questions. It is not a symmetric pool over all retrievers.
known_limitations: Pooled from one arm only, so labels favour tables that arm retrieves.
With the pooled arm held out, correlation against public scores does not improve; this version repairs specific labels, it does not make the benchmark able to rank close arms.
Use as a harm gate and for the 00-versus-08 comparison, not to select among half-point variants.
